user.title: Select OBD dongle
user.description: Choose the Bluetooth OBD dongle plugged into your Nissan Leaf.

configure.title: Set up {name}
configure.description:
Add the OBD dongle {name} ({address})?

Leave the defaults unless your dongle uses non-standard GATT UUIDs.

data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID used to connect to the OBD BLE dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_read: GATT characteristic UUID for receiving data from the dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands to the dongle.

error.invalid_uuid: Not a valid UUID. Use the full form (0000ffe0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb) or the 16-bit short form (ffe0).

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured OBD dongles were found. Make sure the dongle is powered, within Bluetooth range and not connected to another app.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Settings to control the behaviour of this interface

data_description.cache_values: Hold on to sensor values, even when there is no data available.
data_description.fast_poll: Polling rate to use when actively getting data from the car.
data_description.slow_poll: Polling rate to use when the car is in range, but turned off.
data_description.xs_poll: Polling rate to use when the car is out of range. Home Assistant will listen for bluetooth advertisements and update immediately if the car comes back into range.
data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID used to connect to the OBD BLE dongle. Change only if your dongle uses different UUIDs.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_read: GATT characteristic UUID for notifications/read. Change only if your dongle uses different UUIDs.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands. Change only if your dongle uses different UUIDs.

error.invalid_uuid: Not a valid UUID. Use the full form (0000ffe0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb) or the 16-bit short form (ffe0).
